extension.description: Wallpaper, accent color and glass UI for Cursor
config.title: Zine Skin
config.enabled:
Enable skin. When off, the next launch restores the install files.

Prefer a visual UI? [Open Theme panel](command:cursorSkin.openThemeSettings)
config.backgroundImage: Background image. Absolute local path (inlined as data URI) or `https` URL. Or [pick an image](command:cursorSkin.pickImage).
config.opacity: **Wallpaper image strength** (not sidebar/editor transparency). `0` hides the wallpaper, `1` is strongest. For sidebars use Panel Opacity below; for the editor use Editor Opacity. Photos usually look best around `0.3`–`0.55`.
config.blur: Gaussian blur radius in px. When greater than `0`, a pseudo-element renderer is used.
config.size: Background size: `cover` fills the window (recommended), `contain` may leave dark bars, `auto` keeps native resolution.
config.accentColor: Accent / highlight color (hex). Or [pick a color](command:cursorSkin.pickAccent).
config.backgroundColor: Workbench base color (hex). Wallpaper shows through translucent panels.
config.autoApplyTheme: When enabling the skin, also switch to the bundled Skin Dark color theme.
config.panelOpacity: Sidebar / activity bar / title bar glass opacity (`0`–`1`). Lower = more wallpaper shows through chrome.
config.editorOpacity: Editor / panel / terminal glass opacity (`0`–`1`). Lower = more wallpaper shows through content areas.
config.customCss: Extra CSS appended to the generated stylesheet.
config.installPath: Cursor install directory to patch. Leave empty to use the running install.
config.fixChecksums: Update `product.json` checksums after patching to avoid “installation appears corrupt”.
